$comment: Feature flag catalog (docs/feature-flags.md). Every isEnabled('<name>') / useFlag('<name>') / is_enabled("<name>") call in apps/web, apps/api and services/worker-py must use a name listed here; `pnpm check:flags` enforces it and warns once `expires` has passed. Entry: description (what the flag gates, user-visible terms), owner (GitHub handle or team that removes it), default (value when PostHog is not configured or does not know the flag), expires (YYYY-MM-DD: full rollout done and flag removed from code and catalog by then). Example: "new-project-form": { "description": "Two-step project creation form.", "owner": "@example", "default": false, "expires": "2027-03-31" }

booking.description: Booking a call with the team: "Talk to us" in the app sidebar and "Book a demo" on the marketing site (docs/crm.md). Needs VITE_BOOKING_ORIGIN and VITE_BOOKING_LINK as well.

billing-usage.description: Usage-based billing: usage reported to the payment provider's meters, API-key requests counted, and on pay-as-you-go plans the LLM spend limit as a warning (calls stop only at the organization's own cap).

byo-llm-providers.description: Settings page where organization admins add their own AI provider (API key or OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

mcp-tools.description: Settings page where organization admins connect external MCP servers whose allowed tools AI features may call.

mcp-server.description: MCP endpoint (/mcp) where customers' AI agents use the product with an organization API key.
